method: Offline controls inject a unique private marker in URLs/error bodies/open/close exceptions/partial reads. Closed public records reject signed query assignments and CDN URLs with query strings. Only exact verified layer bytes are written; archive URLs are fixed public commits without query parameters. Signed receipts retain only original hashes/counts/validated public fields.
scope: Private redirect body/signature values are unreconstructible; public body hashes/receipts are not a later signature authentication proof. Binary artifacts are verified hashes, not mirrored into this report.
